name: Missing Episode Marker
description: Asks Sonarr for missing episodes and its download queue and burns a marker into show and season posters, so every client (including Swiftfin, Infuse and TV apps) shows it: red for missing episodes, yellow for a stalled download, purple for downloading and blue for a new episode on the way. Unmonitored shows and episodes are ignored. Checks every few minutes, or instantly via a Sonarr webhook. Supports a grace period, anime filler handling and poster repair.
overview: Shows on show and season posters what Sonarr is doing: missing, stalled, downloading or on the way.

versions.changelog: Fix: a season without a poster of its own showed the show cover's marker, even when the season was complete. Such seasons now get a season poster fetched (poster repair), or else an unmarked copy of the show poster, which is removed again with the markers. Poster repair now also covers seasons.

Sonarr decides what counts: unmonitored shows and episodes are ignored (specials rules and the TV shows tab are removed). New markers for stalled downloads (yellow), downloading (purple) and new episodes on the way (blue), each with its own colours and text; seasons and covers show the most important one. Checks every few minutes (configurable) and instantly via a Sonarr webhook; see the README for setup. Banner colours and texts moved to the Markers tab, please check them after updating.

New option to mark every season of an incomplete show (so "Recently added" shows the marker even when it shows a complete season). The report updates itself while the Status tab is open. The settings page shows the installed version.

New shows are marked as soon as their poster arrives (Jellyfin downloads artwork after the scan), and after a metadata refresh. New option (on): fetch a new poster for shows whose poster is missing or a video frame. New option (off): the same for movies. The report shows when a poster is still on its way.
Saving settings that affect detection, rules or appearance now starts a new check automatically, so posters follow the new settings right away. Clearer plugin image.

Markers come back within seconds when Jellyfin replaces a poster, and a series is rechecked as soon as episodes are added or removed. Settings page reorganized into tabs with search, multi-select rules, a specials picker and help texts. Grace period in days/weeks/months/years, schedule setting, progress bar with time estimate, optional menu entry, poster status in the report, and a plugin image.
